pattern: Reference-list entries in a heading-less citation run get sequential [N] numbering + straight->curly quote normalization. Both are deterministic: N = the entry ordinal within the detected citation run (sections.ps1 already marks is_reference runs); quotes = ASCII ' " -> typographic per the codepoint-safe rewrite. Candidate for a reference-normalization pass, not a per-entry hand-edit.
expressibility: principled: ordinal within is_reference run (structural) + smart-quote normalization (codepoint rule). NOT regex-only.
recommendation: Worth examining: recurred across all 24 entries in one run. If it holds on 2-3 more reference-run papers, a deterministic reference-normalize pass would remove a whole hand-repair class.
